resources.string: Solve the riddle, tilt the phone left and right, and roll the ball into the cone with the right answer!
Swipe up to jump · Tilt forward to speed up
💥 Blowout: saying the answer blows up the cones, and the ball races on to the next question

How to play:
• Tilt left and right to aim
• Tilt forward to speed up, backward to slow down
• Swipe up or shake the phone to jump (jump too late and you fly over the cones!)
• You can also hold a finger on the left or right side of the screen
• With voice answers: say the answer and the ball rolls to it by itself
No voice for this language is installed. You can add one in the phone\'s text-to-speech settings.
